Maturita.Name: Textbook Exchange
Maturita.Desc1: A fullstack web application for students to advertise their used books for sale.
Maturita.Desc2: Students log in with their Office 365 account and create posts about selling their books. They can also filter and browse these posts and react to them.
Maturita.Desc3: Site is running on school servers and is accessible only to school students, but you can access the user documentation
Maturita.AddNotes: To this day the largest project I have ever done.
